referenceFunction.includedProcesses: This module includes the transportation efforts for the collection as well as the fruther transportation to the next paper production site / paper sorting plant. No further efforts are included into this module. The collected waste paper has a biogenic C content of 40.4% (average C-content of waste paper according to Doka 2004); Geography: Estimation from the author of the study, valuable for Switzerland.
